sloka: धनुषीन्द्रजितस्तुल्यः प्रतापे रावणस्य च।त्वमद्य रक्षसां लोके श्रेष्ठो ऽसि बलवीर्यतः ।। ६.७६.७७ ।।
transliteration: dhanuṣīndrajitastulyaḥ pratāpe rāvaṇasya ca।tvamadya rakṣasāṁ loke śreṣṭho 'si balavīryataḥ ।। 6.76.77 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Kumbha held Sugriva's shoulders. They were like two intoxicated elephants holding one another's limbs and rubbing each other and breathing heavily. In exertion they let out from their face fire mixed with smoke.
